title: Playing with Celestin; a musician who went to California
summary: He played a couple of nights with Celestin and the Eureka band, then talks about a musician who went to California.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I played a session with Celestin. You know what I said? Played with him a couple of nights. You played Mardi Gras the year before last. What is that? With the Eureka band. Yes.
Oh yeah I remember singing Mardi Gras back in about 1949 I think. And I played with Kid Thomas I think last year we played on the flute. Oh yeah. Mm-hm.
Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
Day and night. I didn't have nothing, couldn't do nothing else. Then went to California, you know he died, you know. Yes, I know. We saw him there last year. We did, huh?
We talked to him a while.
He went out to California and I didn't hear any more from him. Man, just went to pieces.
Well, he looked quite well when I was there. He wasn't playing music anymore, but had a little restaurant.
Yeah, that's what I heard. My brother was out there, he said he met him.
